Recipe.Name: Homemade Onion Soup
Recipe.CookingGuideText: 1. In a large pot, melt the butter and add the onions to cook until caramelized. 2. Sprinkle the flour over the onions, stir well, and continue to cook for about 2 minutes. 3. Add the beef broth and white wine. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer for about an hour. 4. To serve, place a piece of French bread in each bowl, ladle the soup over it, and top with the cheese.
